rationale: Haptic feedback provides immediate tactile confirmation of user actions, improving the perceived responsiveness and quality of the app. Missing haptics on key interactions feels incomplete on modern devices where users expect this feedback.
problemSolved: Haptics are implemented in 11 files (HomeScreen, ContinueWatchingSection, HeroCarousel, MetadataScreen.tv, DownloadsScreen, SubtitleSyncModal, SeriesContent, MetadataScreen, AccountManageScreen, AuthScreen, UpdatePopup). Major screens like LibraryScreen, SearchScreen, SettingsScreen, and AddonsScreen lack haptic feedback.
